description: This file defines route guard components for a React application. It includes RequireAuth and RequireRole components that enforce authentication and role-based access control by wrapping children components and redirecting unauthorized users.

methods.name: RequireAuth({ children })
methods.description: A React component that guards a route by requiring the user to be authenticated. If loading, shows a loading indicator. If not authenticated, redirects to login. Otherwise, renders children.

methods.name: RequireRole({ role, children })
methods.description: A React component that guards a route by requiring the user to have a specific role. If loading, shows a loading indicator. If not authenticated, redirects to login. If role does not match, redirects to home. Otherwise, renders children.
